scope: Supported repository workflows; see external checks for boundaries not proven by CI.

journeys.title: 登录、页面守卫与退出
journeys.acceptance: 匿名不能进入功能页；账密登录后可进入；退出和返回不能恢复失效会话

journeys.title: 邀请注册与邮箱验证码
journeys.acceptance: 未邀请不发码；错误/过期/复用验证码失败；邀请注册成功且不同用户互相隔离

journeys.title: 密码、角色和管理员管理
journeys.acceptance: 改密/重置/停用撤销全部旧会话；并发角色修改不得失去最后管理员

journeys.title: 鉴权、CSRF及限流
journeys.acceptance: 跨身份/机器凭据/伪造来源请求拒绝；转发头不能绕过登录限流

journeys.title: SMTP与one-mail传输
journeys.acceptance: 真实TLS/STARTTLS、认证和MIME可投递；证书拒绝/投递错误不得重试或记成功
journeys.boundary: loopback TLS SMTP; mocked one-mail HTTPS response; real mailbox requires MAIL-LIVE

journeys.title: 浏览器到模型与产物的完整流程
journeys.acceptance: 真实账号Cookie/调度器/模型HTTP/四步工具调用；关闭标签后恢复回复；下载字节正确；502可见；退出后拒绝访问；模型结束前流式正文、工具状态和自动重试可见，刷新恢复且最终回复不重复
journeys.boundary: real browser + Hub + HTTP adapter; only model service scripted

journeys.title: 持久化、幂等和进程重建
journeys.acceptance: 写文件/读取/发布产物/最终回复均成立；重复提交只建一个Run；新app读取旧账号、事件和结果；原生模型/工具检查点跨进程接续，已完成步骤不重放、未知边界不重试

journeys.title: 工具协议与流式响应
journeys.acceptance: 非法点分工具名在独立服务上失败；别名冲突拒绝；JSON与SSE工具名还原正确

journeys.title: 模型异常、超时及错误证据
journeys.acceptance: 401/429/500/502/503/坏JSON/未知工具成为可恢复查询的unknown；不泄漏上游正文、不自动重放

journeys.title: 排队与运行中的取消
journeys.acceptance: 排队取消零模型请求；远程等待及时观察取消，未领取命令不得再执行，已领取结果不明保持unknown；已知取消显示cancelled

journeys.title: 并发、租约和崩溃恢复
journeys.acceptance: 单Run只认领一次；全局/工作区并发上限跨实例有效；快任务结束后持续补位；忙工作区不阻塞可执行Run；已开始但租约过期的Run保持unknown

journeys.title: 模型工作区选择与配置快照
journeys.acceptance: 跨用户引用拒绝；运行配置被冻结；修改目录不改变已接受的请求；配置就绪不等于模型连通

journeys.title: 工作区、沙箱和产物安全
journeys.acceptance: 越界写入失败；主机命令不可绕过沙箱；产物内容和哈希一致，跨用户和篡改文件拒绝

journeys.title: 用量预算与异常记账
journeys.acceptance: 预算拒绝发生在模型前；同一步记账幂等；未知请求计入用量并释放预留；请求级五项Token/耗时/价格来源准确、重试分别记录、刷新恢复及跨用户隔离

journeys.title: 远程节点投递、回执和幂等
journeys.acceptance: 签名/节点/租约均校验；节点执行回执闭合Run；重复投递不重复执行；崩溃未知不得重放
journeys.boundary: loopback account/provider/node HTTP plus separate journal/executor filesystem; signed command checks use injected transport; actual host requires NODE-LIVE

journeys.title: 执行窗口连接及租约
journeys.acceptance: 票据一次性且到期失效；写入租约互斥；不确定的浏览器变更继续阻止接管；关闭/重连/查询均有owner边界
journeys.boundary: window control API; no claim of real PTY/browser attachment

journeys.title: 记忆管理和显式注入
journeys.acceptance: CRUD/搜索有owner与revision边界；必须显式选择；非法选择返回400且不创建消息或Run；冻结内容不随后续编辑变化

journeys.title: 监控、健康证据及事件
journeys.acceptance: 过期/异常优先级准确；重复故障去重；连续健康证据才关闭事件；请求探针防SSRF；同一 report_id 重试不重复历史/事件；回执跨进程与重启持久，轮转和写入中断可恢复，重试续期且过期可重新接受

journeys.title: 只读诊断和审批操作
journeys.acceptance: inspect无任意参数；restart必须有一次性审批；owner和资源版本校验阻止过期执行

journeys.title: 定时任务和重复触发
journeys.acceptance: 过期触发按策略处理；重叠合并不重复执行；失败退避；接口拒绝非只读任务

journeys.title: CLI任务控制、会话采集、原生续聊与补丁交付
journeys.acceptance: 重复暂停幂等且不重复发事件或写审计，暂停任务不派发；临时runner完成任务后Hub必须持有正文；缺失采集即失败；只有ingest token但没有source capability证明的exact事件必须在创建session或写入redacted/raw transcript前拒绝；续聊缺少完整私有native身份时不得启动sibling，有身份时沿原cwd/env恢复同一native会话；自然结束后可续聊，paused/quarantined拒绝续聊；terminate/quarantine/pause/resume 必须使在途续聊失效并回收迟到进程，回收未经确认时返回 escape_unverified；旧进程完成回调不得覆盖新 handle；同一会话只允许一个 native resume 在途；raw transcript retention 每批有界、删除与审计原子提交，且只在 transcript gate 启用时运行；真实补丁可应用
journeys.boundary: disposable CLI executable; actual installed agents require NODE-LIVE

journeys.title: 实时重连、分页与撤销
journeys.acceptance: 重连补全所有事件分页且无重复；会话撤销后现有流不得继续泄漏内容

journeys.title: 会话接管与撤销
journeys.acceptance: 接管回执升级状态；撤销或目录漂移只能脱离，不能杀死外部会话；确认终止回执必须关闭 managed session；投影失败留持久 pending 并在重启后的 poll 恢复，不能重放终止；原终态 reason 不受重放改变；脱管与未验证退出不得关闭会话

journeys.title: 一致备份、加密和恢复
journeys.acceptance: SQLite在线快照与产物一致；空产物可恢复；损坏数据、路径穿越、symlink、错误密钥、篡改和覆盖现有目录拒绝且不留下部分目标；失败恢复清理明文暂存；retention dry-run不变更，应用策略只删除完整标记备份且有界

journeys.title: 控制台页面和文本渲染
journeys.acceptance: 节点/任务/会话/监控页面可操作；历史分页、长文本、Markdown和恶意HTML不破坏页面；助手错误可见、弹层隔离、编辑器滚动边界和实际模型展示正确

journeys.title: 发布探活、旧库升级与验收CLI
journeys.acceptance: 数据库锁定或访问失败不得当作损坏重建；旧库升级失败或进程退出时完整回滚，并发初始化不丢数据；真实账号验收入口固定只读权限；前端release只包含manifest列出的文件且输出目录不得复用；本地/节点HTTP回执、工具、最终回复、恢复和退出闭环；guardian/deployer停止进程必须以pidfd固定经验证的进程实例；发布归档包含进程控制helper；逾期不通过；未知提交按token定位且不重发；旧服务不回退普通入口

journeys.title: 浏览器离线网络边界
journeys.acceptance: 用户URL的loopback由Hub/Node策略拒绝；transport与Chromium loopback只在各自一次性测试夹具中开放；固定目标地址连接、DNS分类、TLS身份、请求预算和只读重定向均受限，只允许301/302/303/307/308并拒绝其他3xx，禁止操作系统二次DNS解析及秘密进入元数据
journeys.boundary: injected resolver/socket, isolated loopback TLS, and a disposable Chromium interception fixture; no Node runtime adapter or process egress proof

journeys.title: 单次表单提交审批
journeys.acceptance: Owner精确授权、TTL/配额/撤销/作用域、审批与命令原子提交、签名及Run绑定、单次POST无重放、错误归因和元数据脱敏均通过
journeys.boundary: real SQLite/worker/signatures/Node journal; in-process owner/Node HTTP; injected model, DOM driver and pinned sockets; all product gates default off

journeys.title: 全流程门禁自身
journeys.acceptance: 必需用例缺失、跳过、xfail、部分参数跳过、teardown失败均阻断CI；只有全部通过才能算覆盖

journeys.title: Agent 生命周期状态与迁移降级
journeys.acceptance: 状态按来源优先级和 sequence 合并；非受管状态降级；PTY 不伪报等待；新管理迁移失败不阻断旧会话采集

journeys.title: Agent 结构化问题卡片回答
journeys.acceptance: 只有声明 interactive_questions 的受管会话可以回答；答案经 Supervisor 入队并幂等；无 PTY 直写；响应重放不重新打开已回答问题

journeys.title: 会话接力创建独立任务
journeys.acceptance: 预览不创建任务；确认后生成新 task/attempt；重试返回同一回执；跨项目、路径逃逸和非受管创建失败关闭
journeys.boundary: disposable Hub; runner and external services simulated

journeys.title: 脱敏会话全文搜索与事件定位
journeys.acceptance: 中文双字搜索、稳定游标分页和详情定位可用；raw/source_record 不入索引；关闭 gate 或索引失败不影响 transcript

journeys.title: Owner-scoped 用量汇总看板
journeys.acceptance: 重复结算不重复计数；provider/configured/unknown 来源准确；未知 Token 或费用保留未知；查询按 UTC 和 owner 隔离

journeys.title: Muse 本地浏览器桥接与签名派发
journeys.acceptance: 持久化幂等派发、草稿保护、消息关联和未知结果不重发；节点必须显式启用且有签名与工作区权限
journeys.boundary: Disposable Hub and real Chromium DOM fixture; real Muse account not contacted

journeys.title: Muse 独立登录态与原生多会话工作区
journeys.acceptance: 导入登录态后无浏览器连接；owner 隔离、子会话、多窗口草稿、卡片、审批范围与撤销、文件限制、未知结果不重放
journeys.boundary: Independent Noise responder, temporary encrypted SQLite and real Chromium with fixture Muse; no live account contacted

journeys.title: 官方插件注册、节点接入及命令投递
journeys.acceptance: 独立插件启停、节点offer与依赖状态；签名命令、重复去重、节点重启和一次性接入文件
journeys.boundary: real SQLite + signed node protocol; temporary gh subprocess fixture

journeys.title: GitHub CLI 插件浏览器贯穿
journeys.acceptance: 下载接入文件、启用节点、检查账号、设备码登录、刷新恢复、停用后取消、登录完成、切换和仓库权限
journeys.boundary: real browser + Hub + signed node + SQLite + subprocess; external GitHub simulated by temporary gh executable

journeys.title: Workflow 领域合同与 operator HTTP 隔离（F1/F2.5）
journeys.acceptance: 严格有界快照、稳定身份与当前证据；真实 Flask/SQLite 的严格请求、同源、跨 owner 404、固定输入、CAS、持久回执和 DTO 脱敏
journeys.boundary: pure domain + real Flask/SQLite operator API; dev/edge identity fixtures; real cookie isolation is covered by WF-08; no live external execution

journeys.title: Workflow 恢复、默认关闭与流程界面（含 F4.3 目录/admission 子集）
journeys.acceptance: 真实存储/备份恢复 frozen 与引用保护；F4.1 V2 发布恢复/配额、未收敛备份失败关闭、未知 schema 拒绝、默认关闭以及 pause/drain/关闭派发后继续在途回传；浏览器固定输入、焦点/读取恢复、等待/未知/验收状态、409、丢响应原 token 重试、390px、恶意证据下载和 Cookie 账号隔离；F4.2 接收四个真实退出窗口、第三次下载后的发布恢复、损坏/未知账本拒绝、丢回执重传和备份保留 waiting_node；固定 Node 导出以原 ID/完整 hash 恢复，Hub 仅接受 ready transfer 的原回执；收发统一容量和真实进程退出释放；双身份 HTTP 交接后独立源码验证；F4.3 原子回滚、reader 兼容、能力快照校验与 frozen 恢复；Node 本地报告与复核、终态/unknown 原 journal 恢复；Hub 可信绑定与自动路由仍开放 External output reader8 admission/rollback, complete historical reference closure, real process crash windows and plain/encrypted frozen restores preserve original execution facts. Native text original Run/reader/message/budget commits survive concurrent creators and three real process exits; signed-rowid128 batches validate all input-reference sets, and plain/encrypted frozen restore needs no current Memory or file re-collection.；独立远程固定测试绑定原接收回执/源码/subject/token/generation，完整报告与JUnit由Hub核验，未知不重放且保留预约
journeys.boundary: real Flask/SQLite/cookie scopes, workflow controls and original dispatch, local POSIX signed transfer/capability reports/preflight; trusted coordinator routes and input-target pinning use original transactions, and Node poll fences authenticated credential before lease mutation. Linux/Windows, physical hosts and external production acceptance remain pending; the local capability-bound workspace digest postcheck slice is covered Complete Native text history and original lookup use saved bytes; current metadata remains outside SQL and final bound authority uses an injected clock.; remote fixed-test capability is local signed-command/SQLite/real pytest plumbing only; no new physical-host or sandbox-confinement acceptance Explicit summary versions survive plain/encrypted frozen restore; original requests use immutable historical closure after disable, while current authorization blocks new provider/send. Summary tests use controlled model and external transport, without real provider acceptance.

journeys.title: Workflow 派发、协调、取消与受控核对（F2.2–F2.4）
journeys.acceptance: 稳定 Run/Task token、32 流程/64 动作、多进程 fencing；取消未确认保留 unknown/槽位；重试与失效保留历史；核对不重写原 unknown Run；取消等待受管 I/O 收尾；独立远程固定测试绑定原接收回执/源码/subject/token/generation，完整报告与JUnit由Hub核验，未知不重放且保留预约
journeys.boundary: real SQLite/OS processes, legacy Task source recovery and leased review/test cancellation; same-attempt retries never rerun commands; no live model or remote-node proof; remote fixed-test capability is local signed-command/SQLite/real pytest plumbing only; no new physical-host or sandbox-confinement acceptance

journeys.title: Workflow 源码采集、独立命令评审、测试与接受（F3 本机受控链）
journeys.acceptance: 固定 Git tree 与 Task attempt 的持久源码回执；原协调器依次派发独立命令评审和真实 pytest/JUnit，校验同一 source subject 后才允许 HTTP 人工接受
journeys.boundary: real Git/files/SQLite, loopback HTTP with Cookie/Runner/production provider, CLI/reviewer fixture subprocesses and leased pytest/JUnit; includes actual macOS sandbox-exec or Linux bubblewrap namespaces/seccomp with unconfined control. Local model peer and tested sandbox profiles do not prove live model, production sandbox or remote-node acceptance

journeys.title: Workflow 有界预算与原账本用量归属（F2.4）
journeys.acceptance: 未知结算不退还预留、迟到实际 usage 仅计一次、Token/请求/active/wait/generation 上限与跨进程最后请求争抢
journeys.boundary: real SQLite/original usage ledger and OS process contention; no live provider usage/cost reconciliation

journeys.title: MCP 与外部 Agent 的本机受限集成（F5）
journeys.acceptance: 固定只读 MCP 目录/schema/revision 与持久 Run 授权；原生外部 Agent Workflow 原 admission 固定配置、稳定 token/journal 身份、发送前持久事实、崩溃只查原任务、取消与自报来源真实；reader 3 兼容备份恢复与 gate-off；HTTPS/JSON/SSE 有界且不盲重放；三工具 Fleet 出口独立鉴权和幂等冲突 Cookie-admin MCP management lists bounded secret-free durable records, reviews full untrusted definitions as text, applies exact epoch/revision mutations, and reads back uncertain/conflicting outcomes without replay across navigation or identity changes. Explicit owner-scoped complete Memory revisions (including schema2 revision0), bounded shared inputs, immutable exact requests, current send authorization and schema3/reader6 fencing preserve legacy prompts and original task recovery. Explicit export-capable adapters return published Hub ArtifactRefs; the Hub validates exact original task/generation/configuration, complete bounded bytes and frozen structured/code schemas; outputs/subject/state/events/reservations commit atomically under reader8, without fabricated validator or acceptance evidence. Explicit local Native text targets receive complete owner/workspace-pinned UTF-8 text with shared Memory budgets, original schema2 snapshots/reader9, current pre-provider authority, exact input-reference closure and immutable target capture. Trusted file-backed normal Hub startup attaches adapters without network/secret IO; explicit CLI HTTPS discovery preserves first active, pending refresh, restart pins and revocation. Preview does not create a store. Trusted Fleet identity CLI previews without database IO and registers one exact immutable owner/integration identity into the normal Hub authority; repeated apply preserves original facts and never undoes revocation or restore disablement. Normal Hub trusted Muse file assembly validates immutable local journal identity, merges distinct coding templates, sends once through the original executor and retains attached adapters for inspection/recovery with external sending disabled; offline journal CLI never contacts a browser. Native preview/apply selects one manifest template and prepares its unique conversation bindings in the original create-only transaction; shape or selection failures never create a store, and ordinary Hub startup reuses the same pure registration parser. Account administrators can register an immutable Fleet identity from the page with a browser-held bearer and digest-only request; original owner/workspace availability and admission checks precede new insertion, exact repeat preserves disabled records, and actual MCP authentication uses the same durable authority. Registration policy responses are correlated completely; lost responses use explicit exact idempotent retry, while synchronous dialog closure or account change prevents stale sends/results. Explicit generated summaries use the original Run queue, a single provider request with no tools or retries, immutable full source/provider bindings, schema2 provenance, explicit CAS publication, and exact token recovery across reload/workspace switches. Full version bytes and mobile layout are checked.
journeys.boundary: real loopback HTTPS peers, Flask/SQLite, local Native Run and original Workflow coordinator; injected model/SecretBroker and controlled Muse journal/transport. Published Hub ArtifactRef outputs, downstream references, exact byte/schema/source validation, real process crash/race and frozen backups are local evidence only. No live remote MCP/Muse/account/approval pilot; Muse export remains unsupported. Memory authority is local owner-scoped SQLite; explicit operator-authored versioned summaries use scoped SQLite authority and complete private Native/external requests, with an explicit admin UI for authoring and history; explicit model summary generation is locally verified with controlled providers; commercial model and production acceptance remain separate. Native text/Memory, explicitly enabled local Native code_revision inputs, and bounded local image/audio ArtifactRefs share the original local Run/worker; source packages use read-only workflow.input tools, while image/audio bytes are re-verified per attempt and never persisted in Run/checkpoint state. Images accept PNG/JPEG/WebP under schema5/reader13; audio accepts WAV/MP3 under schema6/reader14. Each modality has fixed count/byte limits and requires its pinned provider capability. These local media slices have no live provider evidence; CLI/review/test/remote/capability inputs remain unsupported.

journeys.title: 文件完整跨节点交付与故障恢复
journeys.acceptance: 最大分片上传、真实进程崩溃恢复、统一收发容量、Node签收后固定校验；外部双机和OS特定证据独立记录
journeys.boundary: Disposable Hub/SQLite and actual filesystem; native Windows and authorized host probes are separate opt-in acceptance

journeys.title: 能力节点确定性选择与资源容量
journeys.acceptance: Freshness、能力/策略/平台过滤、priority与占用排序、资源累计、进程竞争、自动准入与同代目标固定
journeys.boundary: Disposable Hub/SQLite and actual local processes; Windows/Linux Node lifecycle and held/isolated postcheck are explicit opt-in host acceptance

journeys.acceptance: Administrator edits model URL/credentials, VM execution nodes, workspaces and defaults in one settings page; reload and conflicts preserve persisted state, cached assistant refreshes, runtime file changes require restart and never call an external model. Ordinary users cannot access administrator configuration.

external_checks.acceptance: Each enabled model must complete an actual read-only workspace tool call, final reply and conversation recovery using account cookies.
external_checks.command: python -m tools.platform.acceptance_check --endpoint ORIGIN --credentials-file PRIVATE_JSON --workspace ID --all-models --expected-release SHA --report evidence/release.json

external_checks.acceptance: An explicitly designated mailbox receives the invitation registration and reset codes; both are accepted once and revoke old sessions. Provider acceptance alone is not mailbox delivery.
Each enabled real runtime/remote node must complete its approved fixture task, exact artifact and reconnect/revocation checks. Disabled or unconfigured surfaces are not passed.
Release hashes, account guards, one guardian/worker, TLS/static resources and browser recovery match the deployed artifact; rollback tested in an isolated environment.
Explicitly authorized harmless prompt reaches a dedicated native Muse side chat exactly once using imported login state without a browser; a fresh client process reads the matching response.
